_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Standard and batch rates confirmed 2026-11-03 against Google (aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing), OpenAI (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, prompt-caching guide) and OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, which lists the same rates). gemini-3.6-flash doubles on 2027-01-01 (input 1.50, output 7.50, cached 0.15; batch 0.75 / 3.75 / 0.075). gemini-3.5-flash is not on Google's pricing page; its rates here are OpenRouter's. cache_write = price of tokens written to a cache (GPT-5.6+: 1.25x input at the 30m TTL).
